body: FEASIBILITY SPLIT CONFIRMED. With the same test-only sibling-package classOf anchor in the scratch export, mutate only VerifiedParticipant from private[bench] final class private[nfrd] to public final case class private[nfrd], then rerun with no clean: Zinc compiles one main source AND two test sources; NfrdIntakePublicSuite fails exactly its Mirror.ProductOf refusal, 3/4. Restore with no clean recompiles the same test sources and returns 4/4. So the ordinary class-shape anchors are viable. The isolated Court privacy mutation remains the exception: one main source, zero test sources, stale 4/4 even with a singleton-typed value anchor. This narrows the chief decision precisely to the privacy-only object court rather than the whole file; governing-base authority remains separately unresolved.
